mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances following 2-month INDPRO sub-50 readings.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of over 0.5 percentage points in a single month, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drag on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances following 2-month concurrent YoY declines in HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate over a 3-month period signals a sharp tightening of financial conditions that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following a 1pp 3-month hike in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) shows a year-over-year decline, it signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a YoY decline in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) both show quarter-over-quarter growth rates above 2% for two consecutive quarters, it signals a synchronized demand boom that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following 2 consecutive QoQ periods of GDPC1 and INDPRO growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% on a year-over-year basis for three consecutive months, it signals a persistent inflation problem that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances following 3-month consecutive YoY CPI readings above 3%.
